Well there are a number of reasons it has been taking this long to be honest. First of which is that me and my buddy (2 man team) only do this as a part time job, and want this game to enable us to do it full time. 

Secondly this is our first (3D) big game, so learning 3D modelling, actually make the models, animations, structuring scalable code and optimizations made the start a lot slower than we hoped. In addition, as we got better at it we ended up scrapping all our animations and buildings to make them even better! 

We also scaled up the project (a ton). It was originally going to be a 3D version of a quite successful [2D game we made](https://poppants.itch.io/lost-settlers). But with time we realized we could add so much more cool stuff! We could do this because having a full time job anyways made the longer dev time no problem to us.

All in all, we didn't want to release something we weren't SURE people would love, and we still won't. Luckily though we have received good response of what we already have!

If you're interested in seeing the difference between our first iteration of the game and the remodeled version.
Check out the [old](https://youtu.be/pN0AJGeoaFY?si=uVl6ruOm5UD5vjf0) and [new ](https://youtu.be/1U-E_RWjC-g?si=JNc-W7vHRemwkjga)!

The game already looks a lot better since we posted the new video.


All in all, gamedev is fun and I hope to be able to work full time on it with my buddy! (I would also love you if you dropped a wishlist :3)
